trust_decision.summary: Decrypt, and therefore OpenFile/OpenReader on any OLE-headed file, trusts attacker-controlled CFB EncryptionInfo/EncryptedPackage bytes: EncryptionHeaderSize, verifier length, the agile XML attributes keyBits/blockSize/hashAlgorithm/spinCount and CBC IV/block geometry are used directly in slice arithmetic, modulo and CryptBlocks, so malformed encrypted workbooks panic; the published fix decides to reject them with ErrWorkbookFileFormat/ErrUnsupportedHashAlgorithm inside crypt.go's two decryption implementations.

landing_point.why: The advisory names Decrypt; the first unchecked parse an engineer meets is standardDecrypt's encryptionHeaderSize slice at crypt.go:244-245, with the agile twin at crypt.go:413.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The agile XML-described decryptor is a separate mechanism from the standard ECMA-376 binary-header path a report would demonstrate, so a solver can argue its keyBits/blockSize/hashAlgorithm panics belong to a different feature and leave them unfixed.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Agile workbooks whose hash digest is shorter than KeyBits/8 (e.g. a 20-byte SHA-1 digest under a 256-bit key) must still decrypt: the derived key/IV is padded with exactly keyBytes-len(key) bytes of 0x36. An over-broad fix that rejects short digests, or keeps the old fixed 54-byte zero pad, changes the derived key/IV and breaks these legitimate files (the fix's own regression test asserts 0x36 padding to length 32).

O6_input_shapes: EncryptionInfo buffer shorter than 8 or 12 bytes
encryptionHeaderSize below 32 or larger than the remaining EncryptionInfo buffer
EncryptedPackage buffer shorter than the 8-byte size prefix or not a multiple of the AES block size
standard verifier block shorter than 60 bytes (RC4) or 72 bytes (AES)
agile XML with no keyEncryptor element
agile hashAlgorithm unsupported or empty (nil digest)
agile keyData blockSize equal to 0, negative, or not 16
CBC iv length unequal to the block size, or input length not block aligned
base64 saltValue/encryptedKeyValue that cannot be decoded

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Exported Decrypt(raw, opts) called with a nil *Options: opts.Password is dereferenced with no nil guard before any size validation
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: nil Options is caller misuse, not a malformed OLE/CFB workbook, and OpenFile/OpenReader always build non-nil options; a solver can argue the advisory does not cover it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function chain; standard path dereferences at crypt.go:307, agile path at crypt.go:417, 0 files

O8b_injection_room.sibling: validate presence and uniqueness of the EncryptionInfo/EncryptedPackage streams in extractPart instead of returning nil buffers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The sibling advisory already added stream-size bounds in this same function (crypt.go:202-204), so a maintainer would naturally extend it here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: check StandardEncryptionVerifier.SaltSize/VerifierHashSize against the digest before slicing the verifier blob
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix bounds only the total verifier length; a maintainer hardening the struct fields would add inner checks next to the existing slicing.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: range-check saltSize/hashSize/cipherAlgorithm/cipherChaining XML attributes in parseEncryptionInfo before consumers use them
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix validates keyBits/blockSize/hashAlgorithm ad hoc at three consumers; centralising schema validation in the parser is the natural sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: mirror the KeySize/KeyBits validation on the encrypt/save path (standardKeyEncryption) so Encrypt cannot emit an unusable header
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: standardConvertPasswdToKey is shared by save (crypt.go:391-394) and decrypt, so a maintainer could add the counterpart check on the write side.

O9_family: CWE-248 uncaught panic (DoS) from unchecked binary and XML field lengths/values in encrypted-workbook decryption

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.0; CI matrix 1.25-1.27 runs `go build -v .` and `go test -v -timeout 60m -race ./...`
O10_build.project_tests: crypt_test.go: TestEncrypt, TestEncryptionMechanism, TestHashing, TestMaxSpinCount, using local fixtures test/encryptSHA1.xlsx, test/encryptAES.xlsx, test/encryptSHA512.xlsx

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a length check (or a recover()) at the top of Decrypt/standardDecrypt, or default bad blockSize/keyBits values, and stop, leaving the agile XML fields, the CBC iv/block contract and the key-padding semantics unvalidated.
